_comment: Project fidelity config for add-recipient-business (954:9467). Tolerances mirror account-states / cards. Status-bar + bottom-nav + chevron vectors waived via iconDeviations (Feather icon system precedent).

iconDeviations.name: ^配饰 Accessory$
iconDeviations.reason: iOS status bar (9:41 + signal/wifi/battery cluster) is a Figma INSTANCE; impl renders the same dump nodes — vector-path identity not part of UI fidelity scope.

iconDeviations.name: ^Bottom Nav · 底部导航 v2$
iconDeviations.reason: Bottom tab bar is a Figma INSTANCE; tab icons are Feather glyphs in the impl (home/wallet/credit-card/user), vector-path identity waived consistent with cards/dialog screens.

iconDeviations.name: ^tab·home·active$
iconDeviations.reason: Bottom-nav tab cells — wrapper for the Feather-glyph tab icons waived above.

iconDeviations.name: ^黑LOGO$
iconDeviations.reason: Bottom-nav home tab logo is the bespoke SPX brand mark in Figma; impl uses Feather home glyph (same precedent as transfer-panels chip).

iconDeviations.name: ^Linear / Money / Wallet$
iconDeviations.reason: Bottom-nav 账户 tab — Feather wallet glyph, vector-path waived.

iconDeviations.name: ^Linear / Money / Card$
iconDeviations.reason: Bottom-nav 消费 tab — Feather credit-card glyph, vector-path waived.

iconDeviations.name: ^Linear / Users / User Circle$
iconDeviations.reason: Bottom-nav 我的 tab — Feather user glyph, vector-path waived.

iconDeviations.name: ^Linear / Arrows / Alt Arrow Down$
iconDeviations.reason: Country selector trailing chevron uses Feather chevron-down (app-wide @expo/vector-icons); vector-path waived consistent with account-states screens.

iconDeviations.name: ^返回按钮 / Nav Back$
iconDeviations.reason: Header back-button arrow is a Feather chevron-left glyph in impl; vector-path identity waived.

iconDeviations.name: ^icon$
iconDeviations.reason: Generic icon wrapper FRAMEs (back-arrow + account-type chip icons) — wrapper geometry validated; inner vector-path identity waived under Feather precedent.

iconDeviations.name: ^chip$
iconDeviations.reason: Account-type toggle chip (24×24) wrapper — inner glyph (个人/企业 icons) waived under Feather precedent; chip outer box validated.

iconDeviations.name: ^Vector$
iconDeviations.reason: Inner SVG paths of icons whose parent FRAMEs are already waived above (status-bar glyphs, nav glyphs, chevron). Sentinel vectors render invisible.

iconDeviations.name: ^Group 1707484082$
iconDeviations.reason: Inner subpath group of the 黑LOGO bottom-nav home glyph — wrapped by 黑LOGO above which is already waived.

iconDeviations.name: ^Subtract$
iconDeviations.reason: Boolean operation subpath of the 黑LOGO bottom-nav glyph — waived under parent.

iconDeviations.name: ^Frame$
iconDeviations.reason: Status-bar right-cluster wrapper FRAME (signal/wifi/battery group) — inner glyphs waived under 配饰 Accessory.
